title: Philadelphia & New York City 2-Day Tour from Washington D.C.
includes: Liberty Cruise&USS Intrepid(If price option selected)
New York City Fortune Tour and Night view tour
Professional transportations(Type of vehicle used based on the number of guests attending that day)

requirements: Infants are required to sit on an adult’s lap
Infants and small children can ride in a pram or stroller
Suitable for all physical fitness levels
Age and Safety: Customers under 18 must be accompanied by an adult. Pregnant women may join if under 24 weeks by the trip's end.
Tickets and Charges: Pre-purchased tickets or city passes are not accepted. Buy ticket while booking or via the guide on the tour. Group reservations recommended.

Booster Seats: For state law, Children under the age of 6 require a booster seat in order to participate in the tour group. Please understand that the violations and fines are borne by the guests themselves. There is no need for a booster seat for bus travel on the day of travel.

Booking Guidelines For parties exceeding four guests or those requiring separate rooms, please create separate bookings. To stay together on the same bus, provide all confirmation numbers once your bookings are complete.
Leaving the Group: If leaving the group early, inform the tour guide and sign a departure form. No refunds for unused portions.
Gifts and Refunds: Gifts provided during the tour may change due to unforeseen factors like weather. Fees will not be refunded for changes.

Hotel Rooms: Accommodate 2-4 guests with either two Full/Double beds or one King/Queen bed (based on availability); deposits are processed via credit card. For groups over four or separate rooms, please book separately.
What to Bring: Comfortable shoes and clothes, sun hat, sunglasses, sunscreen, cash, and drinks for hydration.
Parking: Parking is not available at the meeting point. Transportation to and from the departure location is not included.
cancellation: For a full refund, cancel at least 24 hours before the scheduled departure time.
blurb: See three of the East Coast’s biggest cities in two days on this small-group tour from Washington, D.C. Trace American history through Philadelphia, where the Liberty Bell and Independence Hall mark the birthplace of the nation, then head to New York for a guided run through the financial district, with Wall Street, the Charging Bull, Rockefeller Center, and the neon of Times Square, followed by a night tour that shows the city lit up after dark. The next day is yours to explore at your own pace, with optional skyline views at One World Trade Center, a Statue of Liberty cruise, and the aircraft-carrier museum of the U.S.S. Intrepid, plus the architectural Vessel and the floating Little Island park, before the return to Washington, D.C. A night’s hotel and round-trip transport are included.
